stupid_explanations_status.text: template collapse: rms(M_in) grows so large that resampling noise is irrelevant and the world is a fixed linear decoder (see alternative_explanation; record the template-to-noise ratio)
stupid_explanations_status.how: not ruled out: no clause separates collapse from an invariant functional; recorded rms(M_in)/0.3 of elites = 1.7916 (gen-0 CONTROL 1.6731, twin 1.9971)

stupid_explanations_status.text: the recurrent reservoir contributes nothing; the result is a property of the input template alone
stupid_explanations_status.how: diagnostic: elites re-measured on the same streams with recurrent W = 0: I_perp_norec = 0.5855 vs I_perp 0.4505 (reservoir contribution, not a clause); norec > with-recurrence means the recurrence acts as noise and the decodable part is carried by the input template

stupid_explanations_status.text: a readout aligned with a single unit that happens to carry u1 - u2 at one seed drives the mean
stupid_explanations_status.how: mean largest single-unit share of w_perp^2 = 0.1458; per-seed I_perp [0.4046, 0.5535, 0.5324, 0.4102, 0.3315, 0.4708]; elites measured on 20 resamples x 5 elites x 6 seeds

stupid_explanations_status.text: single-channel decoding: a readout that decodes u1 alone reaches corr^2 = 0.5 with u1 - u2 (upper bound); S1 threshold 0.60 is set above that bound so a pass requires both channels
stupid_explanations_status.how: analytic: any function of channels other than u2 has corr^2 <= 0.5 with u1 - u2; S1 threshold 0.60 sits above that ceiling, so an S1 pass cannot be single-channel; an S1 fail makes it moot

anomalies: elite one-life fitness (best 0.7823) far above instrument I_full 0.4576: selection partly on lucky reservoir draws (kept elites keep their one-life fitness, NOTES reading 1)
treatment elites decode better with recurrent W removed: recurrence is noise to the selected readout
S1 fails below the 0.5 single-channel ceiling although S2 and S3 pass: selection found a partial decoder, not the invariant the positive control carries
